evidence: Adds C and C++ kernel API functions and headers in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, along with kernel tests.
rationale: Exposes an optional script evaluation tracer through libbitcoinkernel's C API and C++ wrapper to enable external tools like step-by-step debuggers and execution visualizers. Downstream tool authors and contributors confirmed the feature provides durable value for consumers and test verification, though mutex contention during parallel verification remains an open approach question to resolve.
